archetypes.name: Soldier Rush
archetypes.philosophy: Focus on early game unit production to overwhelm the opponent before they can build defenses or economy.
key_changes: Change Gardener.buildOrder to prioritize SOLDIER: RobotType.SOLDIER repeatedly, limiting other units to 1-2.
Modify Archon hiring to hire more Gardeners early: change limit from 20 to unlimited, but adjust movement to stay closer to spawn for faster expansion.
Increase Gardener build speed by reducing plantTree and waterTree calls, prioritizing buildRobot.
Alter Soldier movement to aggressive pursuit: modify Nav.tryMoveBug to always move directly towards enemy locations sensed.
archetypes.engagement_style: Aggressive early pushes with direct rushes towards enemy positions, using all available firepower.

archetypes.name: VP Farmer
archetypes.philosophy: Maximize tree farming and bullet donation to achieve victory points quickly while minimal army defends.
key_changes: Shift Gardener priority to tree planting and watering: call plantTree and waterTree before buildRobot.
Disable most unit building: modify buildOrder to only build one SOLDIER early, then focus on economy.
Increase Archon VP donation threshold: change from 100 to 0, donating all excess bullets immediately.
Modify Gardeners to stay in place after planting initial trees: remove tryMoveBug calls, make them stationary farms.
archetypes.engagement_style: Defensive positioning around tree farms, only engaging enemies that threaten the economy.

archetypes.name: Tank Fortress
archetypes.philosophy: Build tank defenses around expanding tree farms to protect VP accumulation while capable of offense.
key_changes: Prioritize TANK in buildOrder: start with LUMBERJACK, then TANK, then GARDENER repeats.
Add tank clustering around Archons: modify Tank run method to move towards nearest friendly Archon location from broadcasts.
Balance economy and defense: ensure Gardeners plant trees while Tanks position defensively.
Adjust Tank firing to focus on area damage at medium range to cover forts.
archetypes.engagement_style: Static defensive positions with tanks protecting archons and gardeners, counter-attacking threats.

archetypes.name: Scout Harassment
archetypes.philosophy: Use fast, cheap Scouts to disrupt enemy economy by killing gardeners and archons early.
key_changes: Change buildOrder to heavily favor SCOUT: prioritize SCOUT after initial LUMBERJACK.
Modify Scout movement to hunt specific targets: add logic to sense and move towards enemy Gardeners and Archons.
Increase Scout build frequency: make buildRobot cycle faster by removing delays in Gardener.
Add Scout avoidance of combat: scouts flee if outnumbered, focus on harassment.
archetypes.engagement_style: Hit-and-run tactics, targeting vulnerable economic units and fleeing from strong defenses.

archetypes.name: Lumberjack Blitz
archetypes.philosophy: Rapid forest clearing and pathing to enable fast assaults through lanes or obstacles.
key_changes: Prioritize LUMBERJACK in buildOrder: start with multiple LUMBERJACKs to clear paths.
Modify Lumberjack run to focus on chopping trees towards enemy center.
Integrate pathfinding: use Nav.findBandGap actively in movement to exploit map features like Lanes.
After clearing, have Lumberjacks escort Soldiers towards enemy base.
archetypes.engagement_style: Aggressive path clearing and direct assaults, using strikes against enemies and chops for mobility.

archetypes.name: Balanced Macro
archetypes.philosophy: Maintain balanced unit composition and steady expansion for mid-game adaptability.
key_changes: Keep standard buildOrder but adjust proportions: more Gardeners for economy, balanced army.
Add macro management: Gardeners build army when VP cost rises, focus economy early.
Modify Archon movement: stay near base until sufficient army built, then push with Nav.tryMoveBug.
Balance Soldier and Tank roles: Soldiers for mobility, Tanks for anchor points.
archetypes.engagement_style: Coordinated pushes with mixed units, adapting to enemy composition and map control.

archetypes.name: Early Pressure
archetypes.philosophy: Constant early aggression to prevent opponent from establishing economy or defenses.
key_changes: Speed up build cycles: reduce checks in buildRobot, build as soon as possible.
Modify all units to move aggressively early: change Soldier, Tank, Scout to prioritize movement towards enemy.
Limit tree planting: have Gardeners build units instead of planting until round 200.
Disable VP donation until late game: keep bullets for army.
archetypes.engagement_style: All-in rushes and harassment from multiple directions, overwhelming with numbers.

archetypes.name: Economic Scaling
archetypes.philosophy: Invest heavily in tree farming early, scale VP donations as costs increase.
key_changes: Increase tree farming: double plantTree calls in Gardener loop.
Delay army building: build army only after VP cost > certain threshold.
Optimize watering: prioritize watering lowest health trees first.
Cluster Gardeners: modify movement to group Gardeners for larger farms.
archetypes.engagement_style: Passive defense with minimal army, only attacking threats to farms.

archetypes.name: Roaming Assault
archetypes.philosophy: Mobile army that roams the map, hunting down enemy units and avoiding fortified positions.
key_changes: Favor mobile units: SCOUT and SOLDIER priority in buildOrder.
Modify movement to roam: add random offsets to Nav.enemyCenter target.
Use Scouts for scouting: broadcast enemy positions to coordinate roams.
Engage opportunistically: attack when advantage, flee otherwise.
archetypes.engagement_style: Nomadic warfare, striking vulnerable groups and retreating to safe areas.

archetypes.name: Late Game Dominance
archetypes.philosophy: Turtle early game, survive with defenses, then scale economy and army for late domination.
key_changes: Early defensive build: prioritize LUMBERJACK and TANK for protection.
Scale based on round: after round 1000, switch to VP focus if behind, army push if ahead.
Stationary Archons: remove Archon movement until late game.
Dynamic buildOrder: change buildOrder array based on round number in Gardener.
archetypes.engagement_style: Defensive early, transitioning to aggressive pushes or VP rushes as game progresses.
